# opnsense_dnsmasq_boot (Data Source)

Dnsmasq network boot entries (Services > Dnsmasq DNS & DHCP > DHCP boot).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the entry.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description.
- `filename` (String) Boot file.
- `interface` (String) Interface.
- `server_address` (String) Boot server address.
- `server_name` (String) Boot server host name.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tag UUIDs.
